question: Should core doctor gain this Claw state diagnostics check as part of the Claws RFC stack once the MCP provenance base lands?
rationale: The implementation is technically focused, but it adds a new core diagnostic surface for an unshipped Claws feature whose RFC and prerequisite PR are still open.

options.title: Land After Stack Proof
options.body: Keep this PR in the stack and review it for landing after the MCP provenance base and full typecheck/CI evidence are ready.

options.title: Hold For RFC Resolution
options.body: Leave the PR draft until maintainers decide whether the Claws RFC should include core doctor diagnostics in this form.

options.title: Defer Diagnostics
options.body: Close or replace this PR if maintainers want Claw diagnostics to wait for a later ClawHub/plugin-owned surface.

recommendation.title: Land After Stack Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR in the stack and review it for landing after the MCP provenance base and full typecheck/CI evidence are ready.
